score.summary: Total revenue increased by 4.31% from March 2025 to April 2025.

result.summary: Total revenue increased by 4.31% from March 2025 to April 2025.

findings.statement: March 2025 total revenue was $51,929.10 and April 2025 total revenue was $54,166.66.
findings.method: SQL aggregation using CASE WHEN to sum revenue for each month
findings.code: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN date LIKE '2025-03%' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS march_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN date LIKE '2025-04%' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS april_revenue FROM monthly_revenue

findings.statement: The percentage change from March to April was calculated as ((april - march) / march) * 100 = 4.31%.

data_quality_notes: No null values in date or revenue columns (nulls=0 for both)
No duplicate rows in the dataset
Revenue column has no type problems (float64)
Date column contains daily dates with 181 distinct values
assumptions: Revenue is summed across all transactions within each month based on date LIKE patterns
The date column format 'YYYY-MM-DD' allows reliable month extraction via LIKE matching
limitations: Only two months analyzed (March and April 2025)
No outlier analysis performed on revenue values
Cannot determine if the increase is statistically significant without more data points or variance measures
